description: Clock generator putting out a tempo as a control voltage and as a gate, for the bpm cv and clock cv inputs of the other Surge modules.

params.text: Sets the tempo, doubling for every whole step of its value, from 15 BPM up to 1024 BPM where the module clamps it.
Sets the fraction of each beat the gate stays high, 0.01 to 0.99.

outputs.text: Carries the tempo as a voltage, 60 BPM at 0V and doubling with every volt.
Carries 10V for the fraction of each beat set by GatePW and 0V for the rest of it.

notes: the bpm cv output sets the tempo another Surge module's tempo-synced knobs are read against; patch it into that module's bpm cv or clock cv input.
the gate output is an ordinary clock for envelopes and sequencers, and the three demo patches shipped with the plugin use it that way.
this module is deprecated and hidden in the module browser; the Surge XT plugin replaces it, and both plugins can be used in one patch.
menu: Skins — a submenu of four colour schemes, listed by file name as Classic.xml, Miami.xml, NewYork.xml and Night.xml; picking one repaints every Surge module in the rack.
